compiled_state.title: As a DSO preplanning user, I want the ui-designer to emit DESIGN.md-additions and the preplanning orchestrator to surface them for approval, so that token introductions are deliberate design decisions.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Implements the DESIGN.md addition flow end-to-end: ui-designer emits design_md_additions payload, preplanning orchestrator surfaces for user approval, accepted additions written to DESIGN.md.
**Why**: Token introductions must be deliberate design decisions via preplanning, not rubber-stamped commit-time accidents. The linter is enforcement-only and never adds tokens.
**Scope**:
- IN: dso:ui-designer payload emission, preplanning Phase H Step 7 approval flow, flock-serialized DESIGN.md write, decline path (design:tokens_pending tag), PREPLANNING_INTERACTIVE=false handling
- OUT: Contract document (draft-3), lint wrapper (draft-2)

## Done Definitions

- dso:ui-designer emits a design_md_additions payload conforming to plugins/dso/docs/contracts/design-md-additions-payload.md as a nullable field inside the existing UI_DESIGNER_PAYLOAD ← Satisfies: sc-2 (sc-2: "DESIGN.md addition flow via preplanning, never via the linter")
- The preplanning orchestrator surfaces the design_md_additions payload to the user as part of Phase H Step 7 approval when the payload is non-null ← Satisfies: sc-2
- On user approval, accepted additions are written to repo-root DESIGN.md via flock-serialized write before the sprint implementing the story begins ← Satisfies: sc-2
- On user decline, the orchestrator skips the DESIGN.md write, tags the story design:tokens_pending, and continues sprint dispatch ← Satisfies: sc-2
- In PREPLANNING_INTERACTIVE=false mode, the orchestrator emits an INTERACTIVITY_DEFERRED ticket comment instead of blocking for approval ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Concurrency] The flock-serialized write prevents race conditions when multiple preplanning sessions run concurrently on the same repo.
- [Idempotency] If the same token addition is approved twice (e.g., from two stories), the write should be idempotent — duplicate tokens should not be appended.
- [Linter separation] The linter (draft-2) is enforcement-only and never adds tokens; this story is the only path for token additions.
- [Completeness] SC-4 says migration script refuses to create DESIGN.md on greenfield projects without design-notes.md. But this story writes token additions to DESIGN.md. For greenfield projects, the preplanning flow may need to bootstrap an empty DESIGN.md if one does not exist and the project has no design-notes.md to migrate.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
